root_cause.text: The `sk_setsockopt` function failed to enforce a `CAP_NET_ADMIN` capability check when processing the `SO_ATTACH_FILTER` option on TCP sockets, allowing unprivileged users to attach BPF filters.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a conditional check `if (sk_is_tcp(sk) && !sockopt_ns_capable(sock_net(sk)->user_ns, CAP_NET_ADMIN))` in `net/core/sock.c` to deny the request, addressing the CVE description which identifies the risk of unprivileged applications using filters to leak TCP sequence/acknowledgment numbers.
